svg.title: MeshFill Compute Placement Flow
svg.desc: Complete 3D voxel placement pipeline: multi-asset GPU scoring with priority/weight/quota, dirty voxel-region integration, and instantiation (CPU creates nodes only, no filtering).
svg.text: GPU score/reduce/stamp + multi-asset priority/weight/quota + dirty voxel-region integration + CPU instantiation only. All items implemented.
stamped SceneVoxel feeds the next asset round
instantiate_placement() — CPU only creates nodes from GPU world_results, no filtering
scene_voxel_runtime.gd — dirty voxel-region driven on-demand placement + selective stamp delta writeback
dirty voxel regions feed GPU candidate regions
stamp deltas flow back to voxel field
SceneVoxelLocal upload, dirty voxel-region pipeline, instantiation, and voxel_write_spec commit are all implemented and tested
